content.short: Rampnow is a non-custodial technology layer connecting apps and wallets to onramps across 60+ chains.
content.description: Rampnow connects apps, wallets and end users to fiat on-ramps and off-ramps across more than sixty blockchains through one API. Buyers pay by card, bank transfer or a local payment method, and sellers receive fiat directly to a bank account or card. The service is non-custodial, with payment processing, KYC and screening handled inside the flow. A partner dashboard handles settlement, cross-chain swaps and bridging for production integrations.
